---
title: "AMEP: Adult Migrant English Program"
description: "Information about participants in the Adult Migrant English Program, a free service to help eligible migrants improve their English language skills."
---

Information about participants in the Adult Migrant English Program, a free service to help eligible migrants improve their English language skills.

*Explains program eligibility, tuition services and the population represented by AMEP data.*
